test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A merchant marks his goods at 100% above the cost price and offers two successive discounts of 30% and 20%. Find the profit percentage.
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = 100% above cost price

First discount = 30%

Second discount = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

Profit % = ((SP − CP) ÷ CP)
